mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.project_id, p.name AS project_name, g.user_id, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS user_name, g.initiated_by, g.granted_by, COALESCE(gu.name, gu.username) AS granted_by_name, g.approved_by, COALESCE(au.name, au.username) AS approved_by_name, g.status, g.created_at, g.approved_at FROM memory_project_user_grants g JOIN projects p ON p.id = g.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id LEFT JOIN users gu ON gu.id = g.granted_by LEFT JOIN users au ON au.id = g.approved_by WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND ( g.user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_project_members m WHERE m.project_id = g.project_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('OWNER','ADMIN')) ) ORDER BY g.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT g.project_id FROM memory_project_user_grants g WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.id = g.project_id AND p.deleted = 0)
